documents.title: Divi Lottery System and Odds
documents.content:
# Divi Lottery System

## Overview

The Divi lottery is a unique feature that rewards stakers with the chance to win large prizes. Each block staked generates a lottery ticket, and prizes are drawn randomly.

## Lottery Structure

- **Lottery Pool**: 50 DIVI per block (fixed, doesn't decrease with block rewards)
- **Total Weekly Tickets**: 10,080 (one per block, ~60 second block time)
- **Prizes Per Week**: 11 prizes drawn
- **Prize Distribution**: All 11 prizes share the weekly lottery pool

## Weekly Lottery Pool Calculation

- 50 DIVI/block × 10,080 blocks/week = **504,000 DIVI** weekly lottery pool
- Divided among 11 prizes = ~45,818 DIVI average per prize

## Win Probability by Ticket Count

| Tickets Held | Win Chance (per week) |
|--------------|----------------------|
| 1 | 0.11% |
| 5 | 0.54% |
| 10 | 1.09% |
| 25 | 2.70% |
| 50 | 5.33% |
| 100 | 10.39% |
| 500 | 42.14% |
| 1,000 | 68.33% |
| 2,500 | 93.84% |
| 5,000 | 99.95% |
| 10,080 | 100% |

## How Lottery Tickets Work

1. **Ticket Generation**: Each time you stake a block, you receive one lottery ticket
2. **Ticket Validity**: Tickets are valid for one week (10,080 blocks)
3. **Random Selection**: At each lottery draw, winning tickets are selected randomly
4. **Cumulative Odds**: More tickets = higher probability of winning at least one prize

## Factors Affecting Your Odds

### Stake Size
Larger stakes generate more tickets because you stake more blocks:
- More DIVI staked → More blocks won → More lottery tickets
- The relationship is linear with your proportion of the network stake

### Network Total Stake
- Your share of lottery tickets = (Your stake / Total network stake) × 10,080 tickets/week

## Expected Value

- Weekly lottery pool: 504,000 DIVI
- If you hold X% of all tickets, expected weekly winnings = X% × 504,000 DIVI

## Lottery vs Regular Staking Rewards

| Source | Description | Predictability |
|--------|-------------|----------------|
| Block Rewards | 83% of block reward goes to staker | Predictable, proportional to stake |
| Lottery | 50 DIVI/block lottery pool | Unpredictable, luck-based |

## Key Points

1. **Lottery is Supplemental**: The lottery adds excitement on top of regular staking rewards
2. **Fair Distribution**: Every lottery ticket has an equal chance of winning
3. **No Masternode Requirement**: Unlike some networks, anyone staking can participate
4. **Fixed Pool Size**: The 50 DIVI/block lottery pool doesn't decrease with block rewards
5. **Increasing Percentage**: As block rewards decrease over time, the lottery becomes a larger percentage of total rewards

## Lottery as Percentage of Block Rewards Over Time

| Year | Block Reward | Lottery/Block | Lottery % of Total |
|------|-------------|---------------|-------------------|
| 2018 | 1250 DIVI | 50 DIVI | 4% |
| 2022 | 950 DIVI | 50 DIVI | 5.3% |
| 2024 | 750 DIVI | 50 DIVI | 6.7% |
| 2026 | 550 DIVI | 50 DIVI | 9.1% |
| 2029+ | 250 DIVI | 50 DIVI | 20% |
